name: Wesleyan Science Summer Camp
operator_name: Wesleyan University (Jewett Center for Community Partnerships) with Middletown Public Schools
description_short: One week science camp held at Beman Middle School in Middletown, run by Wesleyan University with Middletown Public Schools. Students entering grades 4 to 6 do experiments, hands on activities and trips with Wesleyan faculty and students, ending with a Friday science showcase.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 camp: August 3 to 7, 8:30 am to 4:00 pm, Science Showcase Friday at 4:00 pm, at Beman Middle School (1 Wilderman's Way, Middletown, CT 06457), for students going into grades 4, 5 and 6, accepted on a rolling basis from March 23, 2026. Need based full and partial scholarships available. Registration is the camper application Google form linked on the page. No price is stated.
